description: AGSC-04-07: all emitted text MUST be UTF-8 without BOM, LF-terminated, NFC-normalized, with exactly one trailing LF. Derivation over the minimal fixture at the fixed build instant: every emitted text file — /404.html and every index.html included, and every .md, .json, .jsonld, .jsonl, .txt, .xml, .ttl and .nq — ends with exactly one LF (its last byte is 0x0A and the byte before it is not), and none starts with a byte-order mark; an HTML page therefore ends with </html> followed by one LF. A binary artefact (an attachment or an asset) is outside the rule and is not asserted.
